milestones.name: Acquire World Sense
milestones.note: Grants completion percentage viewable in inventory

milestones.name: Save Zote in Forgotten Crossroads
milestones.note: Zote held in mandibles of Vengefly King along path to Greenpath; Knight can save or leave him

milestones.name: Zote dies in Forgotten Crossroads
milestones.note: Occurs if not saved before acquiring Mantis Claw; hitting his shell grants the Neglect achievement

milestones.name: Neglect achievement
milestones.note: Granted by hitting Zote's shell after he dies in Forgotten Crossroads

milestones.name: Save Zote in Deepnest
milestones.note: Zote found stuck in spider webs in Deepnest; Knight can save or leave him

milestones.name: Defeat Zote at Colosseum of Fools
milestones.note: Final boss of the first trial; deals no damage due to shellwood nail; grants Rivalry achievement

milestones.name: Rivalry achievement
milestones.note: Granted by defeating Zote at the Colosseum of Fools

zones.name: Forgotten Crossroads
zones.fingerprintHint: Path leading to Greenpath; Vengefly King encounter with Zote

zones.name: Greenpath
zones.fingerprintHint: Area Zote is found on the path toward; Mantis Claw acquired here

zones.name: Dirtmouth
zones.fingerprintHint: Zote appears here after being saved in Greenpath

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.fingerprintHint: Corridor leading back to storerooms; Zote found here having forgotten the Knight

zones.name: Deepnest
zones.fingerprintHint: Spider webs; Zote captured by beasts here

zones.name: Colosseum of Fools
zones.fingerprintHint: Resting area where Zote is captured; first trial boss arena

abilities.name: Mantis Claw
abilities.note: Acquiring this before saving Zote results in his death in Forgotten Crossroads

bosses.name: Vengefly King
bosses.note: Holds Zote in its mandibles along the path to Greenpath; Knight can choose to save Zote or leave

bosses.name: Zote
bosses.note: Final boss of the first trial; deals no damage due to shellwood nail (Life Ender); defeat grants Rivalry achievement

objectives.name: Save Zote from Vengefly King
objectives.hopDescription: Find and defeat the Vengefly King holding Zote along the path to Greenpath in Forgotten Crossroads
objectives.note: Optional; if not done before getting Mantis Claw, Zote dies and only Neglect achievement is available

objectives.name: Save Zote before acquiring Mantis Claw
objectives.hopDescription: Return to Forgotten Crossroads and rescue Zote from the Vengefly King before obtaining Mantis Claw in Greenpath
objectives.note: Time-sensitive; missing this window locks Zote into his death state

objectives.name: Save Zote in Deepnest
objectives.hopDescription: Find Zote stuck in spider webs in Deepnest and free him
objectives.note: Requires having saved Zote in Forgotten Crossroads first; leaving him here does not result in his death

objectives.name: Defeat Zote at the Colosseum of Fools
objectives.hopDescription: Fight Zote as the final boss of the first Colosseum trial; attack him until the fight ends
objectives.leadsToMilestone: Defeat Zote at Colosseum of Fools
objectives.note: Only available if Zote was saved both in Forgotten Crossroads and Deepnest; grants Rivalry achievement
